verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              बाणे तस्मिन्निकृत्ते तु धृष्टद्युम्ने च मोक्षिते। तेन वृष्णिप्रवीरेण युयुधानेन सञ्जय ॥१॥
अमर्षितो महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः।  नरव्याघ्रः शिनेः पौत्रे द्रोणः किमकरोद्युधि ॥२॥
verses.english: What did the fierce bowman Drona, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, inflamed with wrath, do to the grandson of Sini that foremost of men?

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              सम्प्रद्रुतः क्रोधविषो व्यादितास्यशरासनः। तीक्ष्णधारेषुदशनः सितनाराचदंष्ट्रवान् ॥३॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then Drona, like a huge snake having wrath for his poison, the stretched bow for his wide open mouth, sharp Narachas for his teeth, whetted arrows for his fangs, with woves coppery in rage and breathing like a furnacethat undaunted warrior, borne by his fleet steeds of crimson hue that appeared to soar high into the heavens or get at the summit of the highest of mountains, advanced against Yuyudhana, scattering right and left his arrows furnished with golden wings.

verses.sanskrit: संरम्भामर्षताम्राक्षो महोरग इव श्वसन्। नरवीरः प्रभुदितः शोणैरश्वैर्महाजवैः ॥४॥
उत्पतद्भिरिवाकाशे क्रामद्भिरिव पर्वतम्। रुक्मपुङ्खाञ्छरानस्यन्युयुधानमुपाद्रवत् ॥५॥
शरपातमहावर्षं रथघोषबलाहकम्। कार्मुकाकर्षविक्षेपं नाराचबहुविद्युतम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Beholding the irresistible Drona-cloud having showers of arrows for its watery downpour, the rattle of Chariot-wheels for its rumbling noise, the stretched bow for its volume, numerous Narachas for its flashes of lightning, darts and scimitars for its thunder, wrath for the violent wind going before it and steeds for the hurricane driving it forward.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिखड्गाशनिधरं क्रोधवेगसमुत्थितम्।  द्रोणमेघमनावार्यं हयमारुतचोदितम् ॥७॥
दृष्ट्वैवाभिपतन्तं तं शूरः परपुरञ्जयः।  उवाच सूतं शैनेयः प्रहसन्युद्धदुर्मदः ॥८॥
एनं वै ब्राह्मणं शूर स्वकर्मण्यनवस्थितम्।  आश्रयं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य राज्ञो दुःखभयापहम् ॥९॥
verses.english: Against this heroic Brahmana fallen off from all his duties, who is the refuge of the Dhritarashtras and the despeller of the sorrow and anxiety of their king,

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रं प्रजवितैरश्वैः प्रत्युद्याहि प्रहृष्टवत्।  आचार्यं राजपुत्राणां सततं शूरमानिनम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Who is also he preceptor of all the princes and is ever boastful of his prowess, do rush cheerfully and quickly, being borne by steeds urged to the top of their speed?

verses.sanskrit: ततो रजतसङ्काशा माधवस्य हयोत्तमाः। द्रोणस्याभिमुखाः शीघ्रमगच्छन् वातरंहसः ॥११॥
verses.english: Thereupon those best of steeds of argentine hue and of the fleetness of the wind, belonging that descendant of Madhus race, flew in all haste, towards Drona in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तौ द्रोणशैनयौ युयुधाते परन्तपौ। शरैरनेकसाहस्रैस्ताडयन्तौ परस्परम् ॥१२॥
इषुजालावृतं व्योम चक्रतुः पुरुषर्षभौ।  पूरयामासतुर्वीरावुभौ दश दिशः शरैः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Those two foremost of men enshrouded the Welkin in a net-work of arrows and those two heroes filled the ten points of the compass with their arrowy discharges.

verses.sanskrit: मेघाविवातपापाये धाराभिरितरेतरम्।  न स्म सूर्यस्तदा भाति न ववौ च समीरणः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Like two clouds at the expiration of summer pouring their contents on the Earth, they poured their showers of arrows on each other; the sun did not shine then, nor did the wind bow.

verses.sanskrit: इषुजालावृतं घोरमन्धकारं समन्ततः।  अनाधृष्यमिवान्येषां शूराणामभवत्तदा ॥१५॥
verses.english: In consequence of these showers of arrows filling the firmament, in impenetrable and deep gloom created there that became unbearable to the other warriors.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकारीकृते लोके द्रोणशनययोः शरैः।  तयोः शीघ्रास्त्रविदुषोर्द्रोणसात्वतयोस्तदा ॥१६॥
verses.english: was

verses.sanskrit: नान्तरं शरवृष्टीनां ददृशे नरसिंहयोः।  इषूणां सन्निपातेन शब्दो धाराभिघातजः ॥१७॥
verses.english: When the arrows of those two foremost of those accomplished in the use of weapons, viz., Drona and Shini's grandson, had covered the world with that gloom. None could find any interval in the shooting of arrows by those two best of warriors.

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रुवे शक्रमुक्तानामशनीनामिव स्वनः।  नाराचैर्व्यतिविद्धानां शराणां रूपमाबभौ ॥१८॥
verses.english: The sound produced by the clashing of the showers of arrows shot by them, was heard there to resemble the rumble of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra himself,

verses.sanskrit: आशीविषविदष्टानां सर्पाणामिव भारत।  तयोर्ज्यातलनिर्घोषः शुश्रुवे युद्धशौण्डयोः ॥१९॥
verses.english: Then, O sire, the twang of his bow and the slap of his palms were heard in all the points of compass, resembling the rumble of thunder and inspiring terror into the hearts of many a man.

verses.sanskrit: अजस्रं शैलशृङ्गाणां वज्रेणाहन्यतामिव।  उभयोस्तौ रथौ राजंस्ते चाश्वस्तौ च सारथी ॥२०॥
verses.english: The sound produced by the palm-strokes and twanging bows of those two accomplished warriors, was heard there. To resemble the sound that is produced by the incessant striking of the bolt of heaven on mountain summits.

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मपुङ्खैः शरैश्छिन्नाश्चित्ररूपा बभुस्तदा।  निर्मलानामजिह्मानां नाराचानां विशाम्पते ॥२१॥
verses.english: The chariots of both those heroes, O king and their horses and charioteers being pierced with shafts of golden wings, became beautiful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: निर्मुक्ताशीविषाभानां सम्पातोऽभूत्सुदारुणः। उभयोः पतिते छत्रे तथैव पतितौ ध्वजौ ॥२२॥
उभौ रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गावुभौ च विजयैषिणौ।  स्रवद्भिः शोणितं गात्रैः प्रस्रुताविव वारणौ ॥२३॥
अन्योन्यमभ्यविध्येतां जीवितान्तकरैः शरैः।  गर्जितोत्क्रुष्टसन्नादाः शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनाः ॥२४॥
verses.english: I could then only hear the twang of the Gandiva-bow on my right side, as also the sound and blare of conch-shells and drums and the din of many other musical instruments.

verses.sanskrit: उपारमन्महाराज व्याजहार न कश्चन।  तूष्णीम्भूतान्यनीकानि योधा युद्धादुपारमन् ॥२५॥
verses.english: The din of battle caused by war-cries, shouts, roars and the sound of drums and the blare of conchs ceased, O mighty monarch, for none then uttered anything.

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श द्वैरथं ताभ्यां जातकौतूहलो जनः।  रथिनो हस्तियन्तारा हयारोहाः पदातयः ॥२६॥
verses.english: The troops became silent and warriors withdrew from the fight, filled with curiosity, men began to behold that single combat between those two heroes.

verses.sanskrit: अवैक्षन्ताचलैर्नेत्रैः परिवार्य नरर्षभौ।  हस्त्यनीकान्यतिष्ठन्त तथानीकानि वाजिनाम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: Car-warriors, elephant-drivers, horsemen and foot-soldiers surrounding those two foremost of men, began to witness that combat with fixed eyes.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव रथवाहिन्यः प्रतिव्यूह्य व्यवस्थिताः।  मुक्ताविद्रुमचित्रैश्च मणिकाञ्चनभूषितैः ॥२८॥
verses.english: The elephant-division as also the horse division stood still, so also the car-divisions stood still, arranging themselves in battle array.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजैराभरणैश्चित्रैः कवचैश्च हिरण्मयैः।  वैजयन्तीपताकाभिः परिस्तोमाङ्गकम्बलैः ॥२९॥
verses.english: Adorned with diverse kinds of pearls and corals, decked with jewels and gold adorned with standards and ornaments, with armour made of gold, with flags and pennons, with the precious caparisons of elephants, with fine blankets with effulgent and whetted weapons, with Chamaras decked with gold and silver, with warriors on the backs and necks of horse and elephants with garlands round the frontal globes of elephants and with circlets round their tusks, ( Bharata, the Kuru and the Pandava troops then looked like masses of clouds at the close of the summer seasons, decked with rows of cranes and numerous fireflies underneath them and beautified with rainbows and flashes of lightning.

verses.sanskrit: विमलैर्निशितैः शस्त्रैर्हयानां च प्रकीर्णकैः।  जातरूपमयीभिश्च राजतीभिश्च मूर्धसु ॥३०॥
गजानां कुम्भमालाभिर्दन्तवेष्टैश्च भारत।  सबलाकाः सखद्योताः सैरावतशतह्रदाः ॥३१॥
अदृश्यन्तोष्णपर्याये मेघानामिव वागुराः। अपश्यन्नस्मदीयाश्च ते च यौधिष्ठिराः स्थिताः ॥३२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: ऐरावतमिन्द्रधनुः ‘ऐरावतो भ्रमातङ्गैः’ इत्युपक्रम्य ‘नपुंसकं महेन्द्रस्य ऋजुदीर्घशरासने’ इति मेदिनी ॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: तद्युद्धं युयुधानस्य द्रोणस्य च महात्मनः।  विमानाग्रगता देवा ब्रह्मसोमपुरोगमाः ॥३३॥
verses.english: O king, Our troops, as also those belonging to Yudhishthira, beheld that combat between Yuyudhana and the illustrious Drona.
verses.bhavadeepa: उष्णस्य पर्याये अपगमे वागुराः जालानि समूहा इति यावत् ॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणसङ्घाश्च विद्याधरमहोरगाः।  गतप्रत्यागताक्षेपैश्चित्रैरस्त्रविघातिभिः ॥३४॥
verses.english: Coming there on their sky-ranging cars, the gods headed by Brahma and Soma and hosts of Siddhas and Charanas and Vidyadharas and mighty reptiles, all saw that combat.

verses.sanskrit: विविधैर्विस्मयं जग्मुस्तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। हस्तलाघवमस्त्रेषु दर्शयन्तौ महाबलौ ॥३५॥
verses.english: The backward and forward movements and the modes of fighting, o king, of those two foremost of heroes, filled all of them with wonder.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमभिविध्येतां शरैस्तौ द्रोणसात्यकी।  ततो द्रोणस्य दाशार्हः शरांश्चिच्छेद संयुगे ॥३६॥
verses.english: Displaying great lightness of hands, those two mighty heroes, namely Drona and Satyaki, pierced each other with each other's arrows.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रिभिः सुदृढैराशु धनुश्चैव महाद्युतेः। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण भारद्वाजोऽपरं धनुः ॥३७॥
verses.english: Thereafter in that battle he of the Dasharha race cut-off the arrows shot by Drona with his strong and winged shafts; as also the bow of that highly effulgent warrior.

verses.sanskrit: सज्यं चकार तदपि चिच्छेदास्य च सात्यकिः। ततस्त्वरन् पुनर्द्रोणो धनुर्हस्तो व्यतिष्ठत ॥३८॥
verses.english: But in a wink's time, the son of Bharadvaja fixed the string on another bow; but that also Satyaki cut-off quickly. But again Drona stood ready with a bow in hand. As often however Drona strung his bow so often did Satyaki cut it off and this he did for full sixty-three times.

verses.sanskrit: सज्यं सज्यं धनुश्चास्य चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः। एवमेकशतं छिन्नं धनुषां दृढधन्विना ॥३९॥
न चान्तरं तयोर्दृष्टं सन्धाने च्छेदनेऽपि च। ततोऽस्य संयुगे द्रोणो दृष्ट्वा कर्मातिमानुषम् ॥४०॥
verses.english: Satyaki with his formidable bow cut-off one hundred bows of Acharya. However, it was strange to guess the difference between two functions i.e. when Acharya shoot the arrow and when Satyaki cut-off it.

verses.sanskrit: युयुधानस्य राजेन्द्र मनसैतदचिन्तयत्। एतदस्त्रबलं रामे कार्तवीर्ये धनञ्जये ॥४१॥
verses.english: Thereupon in that battle, Drona beholding that superhuman feat thought in his mind thus.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मे च पुरुषव्याघ्रे यदिदं सात्वतां वरे।  तं चास्य मनसा द्रोणः पूजयामास विक्रमम् ॥४२॥
verses.english: Achieved by Yuyudhana, O king-'This force of weapon that I see in this foremost of the Satvata race is possible only in Rama, in Kartavirya, in Dhananjaya and in Bhishma'. So, Drona praised the prowess of that hero in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: लाघवं वासवस्येव सम्प्रेक्ष्य द्विजसत्तमः।  तुतोषास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठस्तथा देवाः सवासवाः ॥४३॥
verses.english: Then that foremost of the regenerate ones, that best of all wielders of weapons, namely Drona, as also the celestials with Indra himself at their head, were highly gratified at seeing the lightness of hands displayed by Satyaki, which resembled that of Vasava himself.

verses.sanskrit: न तामालक्षयामासुर्लघुतां शीघ्रचारिणः।  देवाश्च युयुधानस्य गन्धर्वाश्च विशाम्पते  ॥४४॥
verses.english: O ruler of men neither the gods nor the Gandharvas ever before beheld the like of that lightress of hands now displayed by the swiftly-moving Yuyudhana. Although they, the Siddhas and the Charanas, were cognisant of the feats of which Drona was capable.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणसङ्घाश्च विदुर्द्रोणस्य कर्म तत्।  ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः ॥४५॥
verses.english: Quickly cut-off the latter's bowstring with a short arrow; thereupon Drona that crusher of hostile Kshatriyas, throwing that bow down on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्रैरस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठो योधयामास भारत।  तस्यास्त्राण्यस्त्रमायाभिः प्रतिहत्य स सात्यकिः ॥४६॥
verses.english: Then taking up another bow, Drona that crusher of Kshatriyas that foremost of those acquainted with the use of weapons, O Bharata, placed some weapons on its string.

verses.sanskrit: जघान निशितैर्बाणैस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। तस्यातिमानुषं कर्म दृष्ट्वाऽन्यैरसमं रणे ॥४७॥
verses.english: But repulsing Drona's weapons with the illusion of his own weapons, Satyaki pierced Drona with exceedingly sharp arrows; that indeed appeared marvellous.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तं योगेन योगज्ञास्तावकाः समपूजयन्। यदस्त्रमस्यति द्रोणस्तदेवास्यति सात्यकिः ॥४८॥
verses.english: Beholding that superhuman feat achieved by him in battle-feat which was incapable of being achieved by others and which displayed great tact, those amongst your warriors who were judges of skill, highly praised it.

verses.sanskrit: तमाचार्योऽथ सम्भ्रान्तोऽयोधयच्छत्रुतापनः। ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज धनुर्वेदस्य पारगः ॥४९॥
verses.english: Whatsoever weapon Drona discharged, Satyaki also discharged the same. Beholding this, scorcher of foes namely the preceptor fought with Satyaki diffidently.

verses.sanskrit: वधाय युयुधानस्य दिव्यमस्त्रमुदैरयत्।  तदाग्नेयं महाघोरं रिपुघ्नमुपलक्ष्य सः ॥५०॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, that one who had reached the end of all military sciences, being inflamed with wrath invoked into existence a celestial weapon slaughtering Yuyudhana.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमस्त्रं महेष्वासो वारुणं समुदैरयत्। हाहाकारो महानासीद्दृष्ट्वा दिव्यास्त्रधारिणौ ॥५१॥
verses.english: Beholding that dreadful and fiery dart capable of slaying the foe and of celestial make, that fierce bowman Satyaki invoked into existence the Varuna weapon.

verses.sanskrit: न विचेरुस्तदाकाशे भूतान्याकाशगान्यपि।  अस्त्रे ते वारुणाग्नेये ताभ्यां बाणसमाहिते ॥५२॥
verses.english: When the Varuna and Agneva weapons were placed on their bow strings just at that moment, the lustrous orb of day went below the horizon.

verses.sanskrit: न यावदभ्यपद्येतां व्यावर्तदथ भास्करः। ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ॥५३॥
नकुलः सहदेवश्च पर्यरक्षन्त सात्यकिम्।  धृष्टद्युम्नमुखैः सार्धं विराटश्च सकेकयः ॥५४॥
verses.english: Thereupon, king Yudhishthira and Bhimasena and the son of Pandu, (Arjuna) and Nakula and Sahadeva, rushed to the rescue of Satyaki.
verses.bhavadeepa: न यावदभ्यपद्येतां यावदेवन पराभूते । व्यावर्तन्मध्याह्नतः परावृत्तोऽभूत् ॥५३॥

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्याः शाल्वेयसेनाश्च द्रोणमाजग्मुरञ्जसा। दुःशासनं पुरस्कृत्य राजपुत्राः सहस्रशः ॥५५॥
verses.english: Other warriors headed by Dhristadyumna and accompanied by Virata and his divisions so also the Matsyas and Shalvas quickly advanced upon Drona.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणमभ्युपपद्यन्त सपत्नैः परिवारितम्। ततो युद्धमभूद्राजंस्तेषां तव च धन्विनाम् ॥५६॥
verses.english: Thousands of princes, on the other hand, headed by Dushasana proceeded to help Drona who had been thoroughly encompassed by the foe.

verses.sanskrit: रजसा संवृते लोके शरजालसमावृते। सर्वमाविग्नमभवन्न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन। सैन्येन रजसा ध्वस्ते निर्मर्यादमवर्तत ॥५७॥
